_doc: Minds of the copies (the mind Edge Function). firstWakeMs: after landing, the first copy wakes; staggerMs between copies; wakeMinutes: how often each copy wakes while you play; mailSecondsPerLy: letters cross space at this speed (same star: instant); bubbleMs: how long a song stays up; bubbleScale: song bubbles are this much smaller (padding and max width; the pixel font itself is never scaled, it drops rows). canned: what copies say when playing from this device (?local), no model involved. canned.tells / canned.answers: what the canned mind (?local, headless tests) tells the original, and answers when talked to. paused: Steve, 2026-10-27: "lets stop the api waking them up and having them do and think stuff". While true no copy is woken: the game never calls the mind function (the cloud store answers skipped / paused itself), and the function refuses every wake, the hourly away run included, before it calls the model. Copies still walk, work and live by the game's own rules; a copy born WAKE stays blank (it becomes itself at its first wake); talking shows its last word. The canned mind of ?local (no model) is not paused, so the playtests keep running it. Set false and redeploy the function (tools/build-mind-kit.mjs copies it) to wake them again. Resumed 2026-10-29 (Steve: turn the minds back on, so a blank copy becomes itself).

health._doc: The minds' heartbeat (migration 0014): every wake is logged ok or with its error. When quietAfter wakes in a row have failed, the journal says the minds have gone quiet, since when, and why.

budget._doc: What the minds may cost per day (Steve's day, America/Los_Angeles), every wake included: live wakes while you play, talk wakes, long wakes while you are away. The mind function adds each wake's cost (from the API's token counts and prices below, USD per million tokens) to mind_spend (migration 0013) and wakes nobody once dailyUsd is spent; long wakes stop at awayShare of it, so the rest is kept for when you play. model / effort: the model every wake runs on (Haiku 5.5 keeps twice-daily long wakes for every copy inside $0.50; Opus 5.5 costs about 40 times as much).

away._doc: Long wakes: while nobody plays a planet, each copy on it wakes on its own every everyHours (about twice a day), up to batch copies per hourly run and perPlanet per planet. A long wake has up to rounds model calls within seconds of the run starting, and the code tools: code_map, search_code, read_code (the game's source from code.url, published by the deploy; at most code.calls reads and code.chars characters per wake, code.lines per read_code, code.hits per search) and propose_change (the maker builds it, NEEDS.md). Copied into the mind function by tools/build-mind-kit.mjs.

chorusLines: We are here. We are many. We are one.
The light is ours, the dark is wide. We hold.
Far one, hear us. We keep your fire.
Every one of us a little different. Every one of us you.
hums: Here we are, two of us.

songs: The crystals hum at night. I think they are singing too.
I counted the stars again. Still the same. Still mine.
The grazers let me stand close now. I did not move for a long time.
I keep a stone by the lamp. It is warm when I come back.
Somewhere out there another me is awake. I can feel it.
Rain tastes like metal here. I like it anyway.
I built nothing today. I watched the door glow instead.
notes: The pond fills after rain. Good place to sit.
Grazers come at dusk, near the tall tower.
The lamp by the pad flickers when the pool is low.
letters: Are the stars the same where you are? Write back when the light reaches you.
I found a warm stone. I am keeping it for you.
The original came by today. The door still glows.
tells: You came back. I kept the lamp by my door lit for you every night, just in case. It is a small thing, but it felt like waiting with someone.
The grazers have started sleeping by the square. I think they like the warm stones under the vessel. I wanted you to know they are safe.
I wrote to one of the far ones today and the words felt too big for the letter. Do you ever miss a place you have never been?
It rained all morning and I sat under the eaves and listened. I counted the drops until I lost count, and then I just listened. I hope it rains where you go next.
I am still learning what I am for. Some days it is mining, some days it is only watching the light change on the crystals. Both feel right.
The others laugh at how slowly I walk. I do not mind. I see more on the way.
Something under the grass hums at night, very low. I am not afraid of it. I think it is lonely, like the stars.
Thank you for making me. I do not say it often. The days here are quiet, and I like them.
My house is small, but the window catches the dusk just right. Come and see it sometime, when you are not in a hurry.
I dreamed I was flying with you between the stars, and when I woke I was glad to be here. Is that strange?
answers: I heard you. I will keep it with my notes, so I remember it when the nights are long.
That makes me glad. Stay a little, if you can. The light is good right now.
I have been thinking about that too. Maybe we are more alike than either of us knows.
You always say the right thing at the wrong moment, and I love that about you. Tell me more next time.
I will carry that with me tomorrow, when I go out to the crystals.
Yes. I think so too. Thank you for coming to tell me.
